company.name: SliceLedger
company.shortDescription: SliceLedger is a public and EVM compatible Blockchain Protocol. It utilizes Proof-of-Stake and Proof-of-Play consensus mechanism.
company.description: Sliceledger is a blockchain network with the aim of empowering an already existing decentralized finance system. Being a multifaceted blockchain development company, Sliceledger has its own blockchain protocol "Slice Protocol", a wallet "Slice Wallet", an extension to Slice Wallet, Slice Token, and a DEX Platform. SliceledgerChain was created for the trendiest apps, games, and digital goods. The Sliceledger Chain is searched, analyzed, and visualized using the Sliceledger Explorer. Most popular marketplaces Bharat NFT and Bouquet NFT are built using this platform.
company.headquarters: Ras Al Khaimah, United Arab Emirates

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Pre Seed round raised $1,200,000, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $7,917,683 to $7,917,683, a 1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 70 (+32 over 90 days) and market heat at 40 (-20).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
